description: This file provides a client setup and utility functions for interfacing with Supabase in a web application, including environment variable resolution, singleton client creation, session and profile fetching, and site URL retrieval.

methods.name: resolveSupabaseEnv()
methods.description: Resolves Supabase configuration from environment variables, supporting multiple naming conventions to accommodate different environments.

methods.name: getOrCreateClient()
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton Supabase client instance, initializing it lazily and storing it on the window object to prevent multiple instances during HMR.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Public method that returns the singleton Supabase client, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getSessionAndProfile()
methods.description: Fetches the current session and user profile, creating a profile record if it does not exist, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: getSiteRedirectUrl()
methods.description: Returns the site URL used for authentication redirects, defaulting to the current window location.
